analyst.summary: CAMS is the dominant record-keeper for India's mutual fund industry, a high-margin, capital-light business benefiting from the country's long-term shift of savings into mutual funds. Revenue growth has been slower than the industry's AUM growth because fees, charged as a small percentage of assets, get squeezed as the industry scales and regulations cap costs. The company is diversifying into new fee businesses (KYC records, insurance record-keeping, payments) to add a fresh growth leg. We rate it a Hold: an excellent business, priced for steady rather than spectacular growth.
